{/* HEADER */}
Back Home
{/* HERO */}

Work With Us

Iron Shift thrives on passion, creativity, and collaboration. We are a small, independent studio, building games with what we have — skill, dedication, and imagination.

We currently do not offer paid roles. Contributors may be eligible to receive a share of the project upon completion, based on their involvement.

{/* INTRO */}

Who we’re looking for

{/* 🔥 TABLE CARD */}
Role Recommended Qualification Requirements
Programmer (C#) BSc Computer Science / Software Engineering / IT • 1+ portfolio project (game/tool/system)
• 2+ years hobbyist or professional experience
• Familiar with C#, Unity or similar
Artist Diploma/Degree in Digital Art, Fine Arts, Graphic Design, or Animation • 1+ portfolio project (art, UI, concepts)
• 2+ years experience
• Strong composition & visual style
3D Designer & Animator Diploma/Degree in 3D Animation, Game Design, Multimedia, or Motion Design • 1+ portfolio project (models/animation)
• 2+ years experience
• Blender, Maya or similar tools

We do not base our decisions on skills or experience alone. We are looking for unique individuals with creative talents, ideas, or perspectives.

{/* 🔥 CTA */}
Apply via Google Form

This is a volunteer opportunity. Participation is at your own discretion.
